title: Quickstart | LumenPay Docs
markdown:
# Quickstart

Create a sandbox account, grab your secret key, and make your first payment in five minutes.

```bash
curl https://api.lumenpay.dev/v1/payments -u sk_test_123: -d amount=1000 -d currency=usd
```

Next: [Authentication](https://docs.lumenpay.dev/guides/authentication)

title: Authentication | LumenPay Docs
markdown:
# Authentication

LumenPay authenticates requests with secret keys sent as HTTP Basic auth usernames. Keys starting with `sk_test_` work only in sandbox.

title: Testing in sandbox | LumenPay Docs
markdown:
# Testing in sandbox

Use card number 4242 4242 4242 4242 with any future expiry to simulate a successful payment.

title: API overview | LumenPay API Reference
markdown:
# API overview

The LumenPay API is organized around REST. Base URL: `https://api.lumenpay.dev/v1`. All responses are JSON, and errors use conventional HTTP status codes.

- [Payments](https://docs.lumenpay.dev/api/payments)
- [Refunds](https://docs.lumenpay.dev/api/refunds)
- [Customers](https://docs.lumenpay.dev/api/customers)
- [Webhooks](https://docs.lumenpay.dev/api/webhooks)

title: Payments | LumenPay API Reference
markdown:
# Payments

`POST /v1/payments` creates a payment. Required: `amount` (integer, minor units), `currency`. Optional: `customer`, `description`, `capture` (default true).

`GET /v1/payments/{id}` retrieves a payment.

title: Refunds | LumenPay API Reference
markdown:
# Refunds

`POST /v1/refunds` refunds a captured payment in full or in part. Required: `payment`. Optional: `amount`, `reason` (`duplicate`, `fraudulent`, `requested_by_customer`).

title: Customers | LumenPay API Reference
markdown:
# Customers

`POST /v1/customers` creates a customer. `GET /v1/customers?email=` searches by email.

title: Webhooks | LumenPay API Reference
markdown:
# Webhooks

LumenPay sends `payment.succeeded`, `payment.failed` and `refund.created` events. Verify the `Lumen-Signature` header with your endpoint secret.
